findings.title: Double-clicking Pay creates two orders and two charges
findings.impact: Customers are charged twice for one purchase
findings.likelihood: Common on slow connections where the first click seems to do nothing
findings.expected: One order and one charge per checkout
findings.expected_source: docs/spec.md#checkout: 'each checkout creates exactly one order'
findings.observed: Two POST /api/orders requests, two orders, two Paystack charges
minimal_repro: Go to /checkout with Paystack test card

root_cause_hypothesis.reasoning: Pay button not disabled while request pending; API has no idempotency key

repro_after.observed: Double-clicking Pay sends one POST /api/orders and creates one order and one charge
Same on mobile WebKit; Pay is disabled while the order is pending

fix.notes: Disabled button while pending and added idempotency key on POST /api/orders

findings.title: Sign-up rejects names with apostrophes or diacritics
findings.impact: Users with common Nigerian and Irish names cannot sign up with their real name
findings.expected: Names with apostrophes and diacritics are accepted
findings.observed: 'Name contains invalid characters' for Adébáyọ̀ and O'Neil

findings.title: Product grid overflows horizontally at 375px
findings.impact: Sideways scrolling on phones; layout looks broken
findings.likelihood: Only when a product title has a very long unbroken word
minimal_repro: Scroll to a product with a long title

findings.title: Webhook replay behaviour unverified
findings.blocking_fact: Need a test webhook signing secret to send signed sandbox events

findings.title: Filter chips misaligned
findings.rejection_reason: Matches the design file; tester expectation had no source

findings.title: Checkout summary uses the wrong type scale and omits the delivery-fee row
findings.impact: Order summary is harder to scan and hides how the total is made up
findings.expected: Summary uses text/body-md and shows Subtotal, Delivery, Discount and Total rows
findings.expected_source: Figma: Demo Shop / Checkout v3, frame 'Order summary'
findings.observed: Summary uses 12px text and has no Delivery row; delivery is folded into Total
minimal_repro: Compare the summary card with the Figma frame

findings.title: 'Remove' on checkout is styled as a primary button, unlike the cart page
findings.impact: Users can remove an item when they mean to continue; destructive action looks like the main action
findings.likelihood: Likely on mobile where Remove sits above Pay
findings.expected: Destructive actions use the danger-outline style, as on /cart
findings.observed: Checkout renders Remove with the solid primary style
minimal_repro: Open /cart and note the Remove style

findings.title: Money helpers add naira amounts as floats
findings.impact: Totals with kobo values are off by ₦0.01 in some baskets
findings.likelihood: Any basket mixing items priced with kobo
findings.expected: All money maths uses integer kobo
findings.expected_source: CONTRIBUTING.md#money: 'store and compute money in minor units'
findings.observed: addPrices(1999.99, 0.01) returns 2000.0000000000002, shown as ₦2,000.01 after rounding up

root_cause_hypothesis.reasoning: Adds decimal naira then rounds with Math.ceil

findings.title: Paystack secret key is shipped in the client bundle
findings.impact: Anyone can read the secret key and act on the merchant account
findings.expected: Only the public key reaches the browser
findings.expected_source: Paystack docs: 'never expose your secret key on the client'
findings.observed: dist/assets/index-*.js contains a string starting sk_t…; value redacted in evidence
minimal_repro: Search dist/assets for the PAYSTACK_SECRET prefix

root_cause_hypothesis.reasoning: Reads VITE_PAYSTACK_SECRET, which Vite inlines into the client

fix.failure_signature: bundle contains secret key prefix sk_t

repro_after.command: npm run build && node scripts/scan-bundle-for-secrets.js dist/assets
repro_after.observed: No secret key prefix in dist/assets; only the public key is present

fix.notes: Moved the charge call server-side. The exposed test key must still be rotated by the owner.
